versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the Lord by thy estimation.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando alguém fizer especial voto ao SENHOR, segundo a avaliação das pessoas que se hajam de resgatar, assim será tua avaliação:

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: your valuation of a male from twenty years old even to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
controles.livre: Em quanto ao homem de vinte anos até sessenta, tua avaliação será cinquenta siclos de prata, segundo o siclo do santuário.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל׃

controles.web: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
controles.kjv: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
controles.livre: E se for fêmea, a avaliação será trinta siclos.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם מִבֶּן־חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְעַד֙ בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים׃

controles.web: If the person is from five years old even to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
controles.kjv: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
controles.livre: E se for de cinco anos até vinte, tua avaliação será respeito ao homem vinte siclos, e à fêmea dez siclos.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן־חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: If the person is from a month old even to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
controles.kjv: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
controles.livre: E se for de um mês até cinco anos, tua avaliação será em ordem ao homem, cinco siclos de prata; e pela fêmea será tua avaliação três siclos de prata.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠אִם מִבֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֨עְלָה֙ אִם־זָכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים׃

controles.web: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
controles.kjv: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
controles.livre: Mas se for de sessenta anos acima, pelo homem tua avaliação será quinze siclos, e pela fêmea dez siclos.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַנֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.
controles.kjv: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
controles.livre: Porém se for mais pobre que tua avaliação, então comparecerá ante o sacerdote, e o sacerdote lhe porá valor: conforme a capacidade do votante lhe imporá valor o sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛נּוּ לַיהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: “‘If it is an animal, of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.
controles.kjv: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.
controles.livre: E se for animal de que se oferece oferta ao SENHOR, tudo o que se der dele ao SENHOR será santo.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּרָ֖ע אוֹ־רַ֣ע בְּט֑וֹב וְאִם־הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָת֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.
controles.kjv: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
controles.livre: Não será mudado nem trocado, bom por mau, nem mau por bom; e se se permutar um animal por outro, ele e o dado por ele em troca serão sagrados.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם֙ כָּל־בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

controles.web: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;
controles.kjv: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
controles.livre: E se for algum animal impuro, de que não se oferece oferta ao SENHOR, então o animal será posto diante do sacerdote:

versos.hebraico: וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: and the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest values it, so shall it be.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote o avaliará preço, seja bom ou seja mau; conforme a avaliação do sacerdote, assim será.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עַל־עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.
controles.kjv: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
controles.livre: E se o houverem de resgatar, acrescentarão seu quinto sobre tua avaliação.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת־בֵּית֥וֹ קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall evaluate it, so shall it stand.
controles.kjv: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
controles.livre: E quando alguém santificar sua casa consagrando-a ao SENHOR, a avaliará preço o sacerdote, seja boa ou seja má: segundo a avaliar o sacerdote, assim ficará.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם־הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
controles.kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
controles.livre: Mas se o que a santificar resgatar sua casa, acrescentará à tua avaliação o quinto do dinheiro dela, e será sua.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֣ם׀ מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ לְפִ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer  of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
controles.kjv: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
controles.livre: E se alguém santificar da terra de sua possessão ao SENHOR, tua avaliação será conforme sua semeadura: um ômer de semeadura de cevada se avaliará preço em cinquenta siclos de prata.

versos.hebraico: אִם־מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.
controles.kjv: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
controles.livre: E se santificar sua terra desde o ano do jubileu, conforme tua avaliação ficará.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב־ל֨וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.
controles.kjv: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
controles.livre: Mas se depois do jubileu santificar sua terra, então o sacerdote fará a conta do dinheiro conforme os anos que restarem até o ano do jubileu, e se diminuirá de tua avaliação.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.
controles.kjv: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
controles.livre: E se o que santificou a terra quiser resgatá-la, acrescentará à tua avaliação o quinto do dinheiro dela, e ficará para ele.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־מָכַ֥ר אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
controles.kjv: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
controles.livre: Mas se ele não resgatar a terra, e a terra se vender a outro, não a resgatará mais;

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
controles.kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
controles.livre: Em vez disso quando sair no jubileu, a terra será santa ao SENHOR, como terra consagrada: a possessão dela será do sacerdote.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,
controles.kjv: And if a man sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
controles.livre: E se santificar alguém ao SENHOR a terra que ele comprou, que não era da terra de sua herança,

versos.hebraico: וְחִשַּׁב־ל֣וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Então o sacerdote calculará com ele a soma de tua avaliação até o ano do jubileu, e aquele dia dará teu assinalado preço, coisa consagrada ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
controles.kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
controles.livre: No ano do jubileu, voltará a terra a aquele de quem ele a comprou, cuja é a herança da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃ס

controles.web: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.
controles.kjv: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
controles.livre: E tudo o que avaliares o preço será conforme o siclo do santuário: o siclo tem vinte óbolos.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

controles.web: “‘Only the firstborn among animals, which is made a firstborn to Yahweh, no man may dedicate it; whether an ox or sheep. It is Yahweh’s.
controles.kjv: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord’s.
controles.livre: Porém o primogênito dos animais, que pela primogenitura é do SENHOR, ninguém o santificará; seja boi ou ovelha, do SENHOR é.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
controles.kjv: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
controles.livre: Mas se for dos animais impuros, o resgatarão conforme tua avaliação, e acrescentarão sobre ela seu quinto: e se não o resgatarem, se venderá conforme tua avaliação.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־כָּל־חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל־חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Porém nenhuma coisa consagrada, que alguém houver santificado ao SENHOR de tudo o que tiver, de homens e animais, e das terras de sua possessão, não se venderá, nem se resgatará: todo o consagrado será coisa santíssima ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: “‘No one devoted, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
controles.kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que for consagrado dentre o homens que for separado para a condenação não será resgatado; inevitavelmente será morto.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord’s: it is holy unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E todos os dízimos da terra, tanto das sementes da terra como dos frutos das árvores, pertencem ao SENHOR; são coisas consagradas ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
controles.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
controles.livre: E se alguém quiser resgatar algo de seus dízimos, acrescentará seu quinto a ele.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E todo dízimo de vacas ou de ovelhas, de tudo o que passa sob a vara, a décima parte será consagrada ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it. If he changes it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”
controles.kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
controles.livre: Não olhará se é bom ou mau, nem o trocará; e se o trocar, ele e o seu trocado serão consagrados; não se resgatará.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃

controles.web: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
controles.kjv: These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
controles.livre: Esses são os mandamentos que o SENHOR ordenou a Moisés para os filhos de Israel, no monte Sinai.
